http.description: HTTP listener configuration — where condure accepts incoming connections.

http.listen_host.description: Network interface to bind the HTTP listener to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0').

http.listen_port.description: Port number for the HTTP listener.

http.ssl.enabled.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) on the HTTP listener.

http.ssl.cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

http.ssl.key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

websocket.max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous WebSocket connections.

websocket.ping_interval.description: Seconds between WebSocket ping frames (0 disables keepalive).

websocket.ping_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a pong response before closing a stale connection.

websocket.compression.description: Enable per-message deflate compression for WebSocket messages.

ssl.description: Use TLS to connect to backend

backends.description: List of upstream backends to which condure proxies connections.

backends[].name.description: Logical name for this backend (used in logging and routing).

backends[].host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend service.

backends[].port.description: Port number of the backend service.

backends[].ssl.description: Enable TLS when connecting to this backend.

backends[].ssl_verify.description: If SSL is enabled, verify the backend certificate (disable only for self-signed in trusted networks).

log.level.description: Minimum log level to emit. Set to 'debug' for detailed diagnostics.

log.format.description: Log line format — 'json' for structured logging, 'text' for human-readable.
